notes.content: [p]This is a collaboration bundle between Wise Games and STP WORKS![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025587/d96107081f47471cf9478ab37fa63448ed396f14.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55641/Wise_Games_x_STP_WORKS_Friends_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Play all the coin pusher games you can get your hands on in this collaborative bundle from Wise Games and STP WORKS![/p][p]Included in this bundle are “Coin Push RPG,” an excellent game that combines an abandonment-based RPG with a coin pusher game, and three games in the “Old Coin Pusher Friends Series” that can be played alone or leisurely in a multiplayer setting![/p][p]This is a collection overflowing with love for coin pushers that will satisfy those who love coin pusher games.[/p]

notes.title: We have launched a collaborative bundle with TreeNutsGames!
notes.content:
We have launched a collaborative bundle with TreeNutsGames, the developer of Coin Pusher Casino![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195882/7f97aaf9a7f06226ae3edba22dd7c96dede0333d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54252/TreeNutsGames_x_STP_WORKS_Friends_Bundle/

Discover the charm and variety of coin pusher games with this collaborative bundle from STP WORKS and TreeNutsGames!

Experience the full Old Coin Pusher Friends trilogy—STP WORKS beloved Japanese series known for its nostalgic worlds, unique diorama aesthetics, and cozy atmosphere. Then jump into Coin Pusher Casino, a modern, physics-driven twist from TreeNutsGames, offering fast-paced gameplay, flashy visuals, and a mountain of collectible chaos.

Whether you're here for exploration and story or pure arcade action, this bundle brings together two distinct styles, united by one shared love: the thrill of the push.

notes.title: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3 is now on sale!
notes.content:
The latest in the series of old coin pusher friends, “Old Coin Pusher Friends 3” is released today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040390/_/

Old Coin Pusher Friends 3” is a fusion of a medal game, which can be played by yourself or with others while listening to the Japanese-style world view and music, and a sugoroku game in which players aim to complete the 53rd leg of the Tokaido Highway.

In addition to the same fun as in the past, such as a large jackpot and a nurturing element, various events will occur according to the squares of the “Sugoroku”.
